# Android Data Safety Checker

> Free, browser-local checker: scans your AndroidManifest.xml permissions and Gradle dependencies for known analytics/ads/crash SDKs, and compares them against the Data safety categories you say you've already declared in Play Console -- so a missed declaration doesn't cost you a policy warning or listing removal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
